experiment: Effect of Launch Angle on Projectile Range
description: Pre/post quiz for a projectile motion simulator experiment. Assumes ideal projectile motion with no air resistance and launch and landing at the same height.

questions.question: What happens to the horizontal range when the launch angle is increased from 30° to 45°, assuming the launch speed remains constant?
For a projectile launched and landing at the same height, which angle gives the maximum horizontal range?
Which force acts on an ideal projectile after it has been launched, if air resistance is ignored?
What is the horizontal acceleration of a projectile when air resistance is neglected?
options: Depends only on the launch angle

questions.question: If the initial launch speed is increased while the launch angle remains the same, what generally happens to the horizontal range?

Two projectiles are launched with the same speed at 30° and 60° from the same height. Under ideal conditions, how do their horizontal ranges compare?
